turns.text: Yeah, I noticed that during the interview.
turns.zh: 嗯，面试的时候我就注意到了。

turns.text: Speaking of which, how did you end up in marketing?
turns.zh: 说到这个，你是怎么进入市场营销这一行的？

turns.text: Did you always want to work in this field?
turns.zh: 你一直都想做这个领域的工作吗？

turns.text: I actually studied journalism in college, but after graduation, I couldn't find any good positions at newspapers or magazines.
turns.zh: 我大学其实学的是新闻，但毕业之后，在报社或杂志社都找不到什么好职位。

turns.text: So, I decided to try marketing, and it turns out I really enjoy it.
turns.zh: 所以我就决定试试市场营销，结果发现我还挺喜欢的。

turns.text: I studied graphic design, so this creative team role feels like a natural fit, but I've always been curious about the marketing side of things.
turns.zh: 我学的是平面设计，所以这个创意团队的岗位感觉挺对口的，但我一直对市场营销那块挺好奇的。
